save.text: Giveaway hit 4,200 subs: winner LL1973; prize signed 5e PHB + cast photo; new giveaways every +50 subs (next at 4,250).
No Critical Role next week due to SDCC; panels Thu at Petco Park: Geek & Sundry 1–2 (Matt, Laura), Critical Role 4–5; no badge needed; panel will be filmed and streamed next day.
Following week Matt and Marisha in New Zealand for Armageddon; two weeks without main-story; remaining cast will stream other games/chat.
Intro video malfunction; they were already live; decided to skip intro and start game; Orion was Periscoping thinking they weren’t live.

Sam arrived late, mid-intro recap; party on a 6–7 day skyship journey to Vasselheim with the Horn of Orcus after wyvern/griffon attacker encounter; took a captive; horn in holy container, indestructible as far as known.
Ashley present on mic/camera; planned to show a guest at break, not immediately.
Captured halfling mage from attacker band is locked in the ship’s anti-magic brig by Captain Damon; he rejected hiring her for now; fate pending.
Several uneventful travel days pass over the Ozmit Sea; party fully rested with spells returned; nearing Vasselheim soon per ongoing skyship journey.
Grog’s magical beard growth continues: translucent/gray stubble ~1–1.5 inches; Keyleth braided with beads/flowers; Vax later glued rope goatee on sleeping Grog (undetected).
Grog wakes with a dark brown, well-braided goatee braid ~3–4 inches; previously pale stubble now a single darker strand noted; he’s proud and it stays taut.
Mid-6th day of skyship travel, weather turns colder and gloomier toward the northern continent; Keyleth’s Nature check (20) confirms natural, not arcane.
Tiberius persuades Scanlan to trade items: Scanlan agrees to swap his circlet/crown for Tiberius’s Ioun Stone after argument about usage and action economy.
Scanlan accepts Tiberius’s trade: gives circlet/crown for Tiberius’s Ioun Stone; party praises the convincing argument; Ioun Stone now orbiting Scanlan.
As they near Vasselheim, temperature drops; first snow seen from clouds ahead during skyship travel.
Keyleth reveals Fire Ashari live near Vasselheim in Pyrah; proposes visiting after handling the Horn as part of her Aramente to meet headmasters and prove leadership.

Approaching Vasselheim on Othanzia: Vesper Timberland visible with light snowfall; Kima confirms location and guides; city heavily fortified with layered ancient/new walls and dragon-headed ballistae.
Keyleth shares her mother left when Keyleth was ~5–6; tribe unknown; may ask Ashari near Vasselheim if they've seen her; party agrees to accompany.
Keyleth expects no hostility visiting Fire Ashari in Pyrah; party plans to stop by after Horn business as part of her Aramente.
First arrival to Vasselheim for the party; climate is chilly; Vex passes out winter coats bought earlier; some fancy robes also handed out; Tiberius keeps his cloak.
Scanlan stores a 3rd-level Lightning Bolt into the white Ioun Stone; the stored energy glows greenish-blue; uses a spell slot now, will be saved after rest.

Vasselheim shows scars and repeatedly rebuilt walls; skyship landing on a makeshift mill-top platform; skyship travel here is rare; Kima appears anxious and offers to guide questions; escorts expected to guide Horn delivery.
Arrival party met by Scalebearer Yonn and rough militia; Yonn will escort Vox Machina to Platinum Sanctuary (~25-min walk) to dispose of the Horn.
Kima admits she hasn’t been with her Order properly for eight years; appears nervous about meeting them.
Vasselheim restricts arcane magic; no arcane temples/sigils; city is primarily divine/holy per Yonn.
Vasselheim guards display holy symbols; prevalent worship of Erathis, Avandra, Melora, some Bahamut; notably none of Sarenrae.
Tiberius’s red dragonborn appearance makes locals nervous; claims Stormwind family mostly metallic; he casts Alter Self to appear gold; warned not to use arcane openly.
Escort plan: Keyleth scouts as eagle; Vex attempts rooftop overwatch but rolls a 1 and is noticed; Vax stealths with 23; Grog/Pike on path; Tiberius takes rear; Liam blends with crowd.
Vasselheim: harsh, oldest known bastion; holiest city with oldest temples to good/neutral deities; public arcane deemed profane and tightly controlled.
Escorted up mountain stairs (~15–20 min) to Platinum Sanctuary; fortress built into mountain; three later-added ivory/silver spires; Bahamut symbol on great doors.
Public arcane taboo re-affirmed; party plans to be sneaky with spells; Grog says he’ll pocket spells; guards still flank the group en route.
Bastions: volunteer civilian militia; about a quarter of Vasselheim’s populace; patchwork armor; envoys in blue/silver from Bahamut temple are distinct.
Outside city: large multi-serpentine creature (likely hydra) commonly approaches; Bastions fire ballista; it retreats; moving trees seen; heavy snowfall, dense canopy.
Keyleth scouts as eagle outside city, sees threat; returns via arrow slit, shifts form inside, confronted by Platinum Dragon guards and must persuade them she’s with Vox Machina.
Keyleth was cuffed by Platinum Dragon guards for sneaking in; Kima vouched for her, cuffs removed, guards apologized and left.
Kima’s authority with the Scalebearers is strong; she rebuked party for fraternizing in Bahamut’s temple.
Temple of Bahamut (Vasselheim): austere stone fortress, ancient, humming with divine power even if different from Pike’s; very holy.
Temple of Bahamut inner sanctum: double doors open by Yonn’s glowing holy symbol; domed 80-ft chamber with ancient mural of creation, planes, Bahamut battling five‑headed Tiamat.
Highbearer Vord (elder elf, white hair) greets as Keeper of the Platinum Sanctuary; Kima is his disciple and kneels to him.
Vord confirms container holds a true Horn of Orcus via divine pulse; says it must be sealed immediately; warns its presence bodes ill.

Plan: Seal Horn in the Hall of the Exalt beneath the Platinum Sanctuary; party must clear foul subterranean spider infestation and navigate some activated vault defenses; Scalebearers will carry the reliquary with the party, who must keep them safe.

Hall/vault history: Star of Exaltation (Bahamut’s tear) once housed there; created in the Dawn War; expended protecting Vasselheim ~300 years ago during a siege and ceased to exist by Bahamut’s will; chamber has remained maintained; last full cleansing ~15 years ago.
Yonn (Scalebearer) fled preparing the lower chambers and inadvertently activated some defenses; Vord still vouches he has devotion despite an addled mind.
Vex uses Primeval Awareness in Vasselheim; detects no dragons within six miles.
Vord insists sealing the Horn immediately; party agrees to clear the Hall now, morning of arrival.
Temple offers 3,000 gp total after sealing; Scanlan’s Deception 30 secures agreement; Kima objects but relents.
Platinum Sanctuary vault entrance revealed by Kima placing her holy symbol into recessed slot; wood illusion dispelled to a stone doorway and stairway down.

First vault chamber: 50x50 ft, low sconces, thick white mist generated from dragon‑headed carvings on two floor‑to‑ceiling pillars; pillars have slight gap at base indicating rotation/pivot; mist quickly refills; Keyleth can clear center briefly with Gust of Wind.
Tiberius reassigns three communication earrings to Vax, Grog, and Scanlan; Vex loses hers; rationale: front‑liners need them; party still at stairway during reassignment.

Mist cleared briefly let party rush center; Vax brushed mist, triggering spinning dragon-mouth flame trap; Keyleth, Scanlan, Pike failed saves taking 24 fire; Tiberius took 12; Vax evaded all via Uncanny Dodge; trap resets as mist refills quickly.
Scalebearers are actively accompanying through the vault rooms; party got split by trap but regrouped after Keyleth spent a 2nd Gust of Wind to clear a path for the rest within a minute.
Keyleth expended two Gust of Wind spell slots to traverse first chamber; must keep wind centered to avoid triggering pillar trap.
Party cleared first mist chamber; room refilled after crossing; moved into dark circular room with floor of marked circles; next area has a wide 20‑ft descending staircase visible across.
Second chamber trap: touching a circle triggered rotating room with pistoning stone pillars smashing into ceiling; requires acrobatics to traverse.
Vax sprinted in using Boots of Haste, triggered trap; made multiple acrobatics/saves, was launched and took 40 crushing damage before continuing.
Grog’s beard revealed as fake; it tears off when offered for luck. Vex keeps it as “Fake Grog Rope Beard” inventory item; Matt notes it will come into play.
In rotating pillar trap room, a quarter-sized hole is in the ceiling at the center, only visible when the central pillar retracts; likely a shutdown mechanism.
Vex, inspired by Scanlan, makes a precision shot at the ceiling hole and hits with a 35 attack; Tiberius attempts to assist with Telekinesis mid-flight.
Vex’s arrow shot at the ceiling hole succeeds; Tiberius’s Telekinesis nudges it for a 17 check, triggering shutdown: splintering wood/metal, grinding, pillars halt.
Rotating pillar trap disabled via ceiling-hole shot; party crosses safely, Vax injured; they begin a short rest to spend hit dice.
Session pauses for a five-minute break; stream aims to end by 10; charity segment with GameChanger guest Taylor Carol begins.

Charity segment: GameChanger featured; donations tonight redirected from 826LA to GameChanger; Deus Ex promo: donate >$1 at gamechangercharity.org for free Director’s Cut; site briefly crashed from traffic; mods push link in chat; promo last day.
